questions.stemHtml: Cardiac muscle cells (cardiomyocytes) are striated, branched, and connected end-to-end by intercalated discs that facilitate synchronized contraction. questions.stemHtml: A 26-year-old woman was admitted in the emergency room with severe epigastric pain with radiation to the back, nausea, anorexia, jaundice, 38.5 ºC fever, headache and myalgia. Examination revealed a woman with severe jaundice, pallor, and epigastric abdominal pain during superficial palpation, with no peritonitis signs. Her liver was enlarged, exceeding costal margin by 2 cm. Laboratory investigations showed serum aspartate aminotransferase (AST) 1,285 IU/L (13-35 IU/dL), alanine aminotransferase (ALT) 666 IU/L (7-35 IU/dL), lipase 1,012 IU/L (≤ 200 IU/L), amylase 149 IU/L (20-110UI/L). She was diagnosed with acute pancreatitis. In this case which arterial aneurism may be seen?
